name: Elevação de pernas (solo)
directions: SUPINE FLOOR LEG RAISE, sixframes3x2. Back of HEAD, SHOULDERS, entire BACK AND SACRUM/PELVIS stay FLAT ON FLOOR in ALLsixframes. Only both legs rotate at hip joints. NO reversecrunch or pelvis lifting at end. Start long legs hoverjustabovfloor. Frame2 legs30degrees, frame3 legs60degrees, frame4 legs90degrees vertical ABOVE hips but BUTTOCKS STILLONFLOOR, frame5 legs45degrees, frame6 hoverinitial. Both arms restingonfloorpalmsdown, head relaxed supported. Hipcrease stays at SAME LOW coordinate in everyframe, neverpullkneestochest. Maintainneutrallumbar.
instructions: Deitado, mãos sob a lombar se precisar.
Desça devagar sem tocar o chão.
